Messages.Body:
lek...@cs.usask.ca (Lee Kennedy) writes:

>Can a methuselah send one of his vampires to commit diablerie against another
>of his own vampires?

Yes, this action would be at +1 stealth, and any Methuselah
could call a vote to burn the diablerizing Vampire after the
action.

Messages.Author: Bob Ellison
Messages.Body:
> Can a methuselah send one of his vampires to commit diablerie against another
> of his own vampires?

Yep - at +1 stealth (12.3.1, Encounter Vampire in Torpor) because the
vampire is controlled by you.

Watch out for bloodhunt votes, though...
